content: The text is too long. The maximum length is {{limit}} characters.

comment.text: Error shown in red under a text field of the AI project form or its add/edit suggestion dialog when the entered text is longer than allowed; {{limit}} is the maximum number of characters (255 for a suggestion label, 10000 for the instructions or a prompt). Full sentence.

usage.context:
<FieldContainer
 isVertical
 removeMargin
 labelVisible={false}
 hasError={instructionsTooLong}
 errorMessage={t("Common:AIProjectTextTooLong", { limit: AI_PROJECT_MAX_TEXT_LENGTH })}
 errorMessageWidth="100%"
 >
 <Textarea
 value={prompt}
 onChange={(e) => setPrompt(e.target.value)}

<FieldContainer
 isVertical
 removeMargin
 labelVisible={false}
 hasError={nameTooLong}
 errorMessage={t("Common:AIProjectTextTooLong", { limit: AI_PROJECT_MAX_SUGGESTION_NAME_LENGTH })}
 errorMessageWidth="100%"
 >
 <TextInput
 id="ai-project-suggestion-name"
 type={InputType.text}
